raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 15 raw_transactions rows with status 'REVERSAL' point to original POSTED transactions via orig_txn_id, but silver_transactions keeps those originals while dropping the reversal rows, so reversed amounts stay in gold, mostly in the recent batches. The fix is to also exclude any POSTED transaction referenced as orig_txn_id by a REVERSAL row; this is harmless for originals already marked REVERSED.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) NOT IN (SELECT CAST(orig_txn_id AS BIGINT) FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL);"}}
